title: Bloom Energy (BE) Rose on AI Data Center Power Demand
excerpt: Columbia Threadneedle Investments, an investment management company, released its “Columbia Seligman Global Technology Fund” second quarter 2026 investor let...
content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Tue, July 28, 2026 at 7:01 AM PDT 3 min read

Columbia Threadneedle Investments, an investment management company, released its "Columbia Seligman Global Technology Fund" second quarter 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. During the quarter, the Fund's Institutional Class shares returned 50.34%, outperforming the MSCI World Information Technology Index's 33.65% gain. Stock selection in semiconductors, technology hardware and software, together with an off-benchmark electrical equipment allocation, supported relative performance, while exposure to financials, consumer discretionary and healthcare detracted. Technology stocks rallied as concerns over the Iran conflict eased and AI infrastructure spending boosted demand for semiconductors, memory, networking, servers and power solutions. The Fund expects AI and data-centre investment to remain strong, supported by broadening earnings growth and improving software bookings, cloud consumption and customer spending. However, geopolitical uncertainty, higher interest rates and heavy AI investment could pressure valuations and free cash flow. The strategy holds 50–75 technology companies across market capitalisations and uses bottom-up GARP research to identify misunderstood and undervalued businesses in the technology industry. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Columbia Seligman Global Technology Fund highlighted Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE) as a leading contributor. Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE) is an energy company that designs and manufactures solid-oxide fuel cell systems for clean, reliable, on-site power generation. On July 27, 2026, Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE) closed at $188.18 per share. One-month return of Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE) was -37.83% and its shares gained 441.53% over the past 52 weeks. Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE) has a market capitalization of $53.53 billion.

Columbia Seligman Global Technology Fund stated the following regarding Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"The fund continued to hold an off-benchmark position in Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE:BE). The company manufactures and markets solid-oxide fuel cells that produce electricity and can provide an alternative source of energy compared to traditional supply. Data-center operators have increasingly turned to Bloom's solid-oxide fuel cells to bypass grid constraints and power energy-intensive AI workloads. The optimism around Bloom continued during the quarter, with expectations that accelerating AI data-center construction would drive demand for reliable, onsite power-generation solutions, particularly as utilities struggled to provide sufficient grid capacity in many regions. The stock also benefited from growing recognition of Bloom's fuel-cell technology as a potential bridge solution for powering AI infrastructure, supporting expectations for stronger bookings and long-term revenue."

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 7 月 28 日星期二上午 7:01 阅读时间 3 分钟

投资管理公司 Columbia Threadneedle Investments 发布了“哥伦比亚塞利格曼全球科技基金”2026 年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 本季度，该基金的机构类别股票回报率为 50.34%，跑赢 MSCI 世界信息技术指数 33.65% 的涨幅。 半导体、技术硬件和软件的股票选择以及非基准电气设备配置支撑了相对表现，而金融、非必需消费品和医疗保健的敞口则受到影响。 随着对伊朗冲突的担忧缓解以及人工智能基础设施支出提振了对半导体、内存、网络、服务器和电源解决方案的需求，科技股上涨。 该基金预计，在盈利增长扩大以及软件预订、云消费和客户支出改善的支持下，人工智能和数据中心投资将保持强劲。 然而，地缘政治的不确定性、较高的利率和大量的人工智能投资可能会给估值和自由现金流带来压力。 该战略持有 50-75 家不同市值的科技公司，并利用自下而上的 GARP 研究来识别科技行业中被误解和低估的企业。 此外，请查看该基金的前五名持股，以了解其2026年的最佳选择。

哥伦比亚塞利格曼全球技术基金在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信中强调，布鲁姆能源公司（NYSE：BE）是主要贡献者。 Bloom Energy Corporation（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BE）是一家能源公司，致力于设计和制造用于清洁、可靠的现场发电的固体氧化物燃料电池系统。 2026 年 7 月 27 日，Bloom Energy Corporation（纽约证券交易所代码：BE）收于每股 188.18 美元。 布鲁姆能源公司（NYSE：BE）的一个月回报率为-37.83%，其股价在过去 52 周内上涨了 441.53%。 布鲁姆能源公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BE）的市值为 535.3 亿美元。

哥伦比亚塞利格曼全球技术基金在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就 Bloom Energy Corporation（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BE）发表了以下声明：

“该基金继续持有布鲁姆能源公司（NYSE：BE）的非基准头寸。 该公司生产和销售固体氧化物燃料电池，该电池可以产生电力，并且与传统供应相比可以提供替代能源。 数据中心运营商越来越多地转向 Bloom 的固体氧化物燃料电池，以绕过电网限制并为能源密集型人工智能工作负载提供动力。 本季度，围绕 Bloom 的乐观情绪仍在继续，人们预计人工智能数据中心建设的加速将推动对可靠的现场发电解决方案的需求，特别是在公用事业公司难以在许多地区提供足够的电网容量的情况下。 该股还受益于人们越来越认识到 Bloom 的燃料电池技术是为人工智能基础设施提供动力的潜在桥梁解决方案，支持了更强劲的预订和长期收入的预期。”
